MANGO STATIC / TRANSMISSION 001

Small gathering.
Big party energy.

A small get-together turning into a proper party. Start soulful, build the percussion, finish with energy.

  1. 01 / Start with soulLet people settle in. Warm chords, good gist, a little head-nodding.
  2. 02 / Find the pulseLet percussion lead the build. Afro house and Afrobeats can be starting points.
  3. 03 / Let it goNow the room is ready. Bring a joyful lift, an electronic touch, or that unexpected track. Make it yours.

No fixed length or BPM. Send a link to your own interpretation hosted on a service you choose. Include your DJ name for credit.
